up: For the assay with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1614031, retrieve all activity measurements (including standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value, bao_endpoint) along with the canonical SMILES of the tested compounds. Each row should correspond to one activity measurement, with the compound structure attached.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, a.bao_endpoint, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614031';
